sqlGroup.select: select a.id as id, a.remark as remark, a.approval_status as approvalStatus, date_format( a.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as createdTime, cs.`name` AS createdStaffName from jml_parts_purchase_approval_history a left join jml_staff cs ON a.created_staff_id = cs.id where a.parts_purchase_id = #{partsPurchaseId} order by a.created_time desc
